### Compression spring design

Given a design factor of 1.5 against the torsional yield strength, and a working load of 10 lbf at 0.5 in deflection:

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Wire | Music wire (ASTM A228), d = 0.055 in |
| Mean diameter | D = 0.50 in |
| Spring index | C = 9.1 |
| Active coils | 8 |
| Ends | Squared and ground |
| Free length | 1.25 in |
| Rate | 20 lbf/in |

Shear stress with the Wahl factor K_w = 1.16: τ = K_w · 8FD/(πd³) = 89,000 psi.

Allowable: 0.45 × S_ut = 0.45 × 260 ksi = 117 ksi, so FS ≥ 1.3 — fine.

The solid height is 10 × 0.055 = 0.55 in, so coil bind is avoided. Check buckling: L0/D = 2.5 < 5.26, no buckling for squared and ground ends.
